subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode — the roadmap

question: Should OpenClaw accept Codex-style structured questions, plan mode, and goal-mode continuation as core runtime features now, and should the paired implementation land as one branch or be split?
rationale: The request changes cross-surface core interaction policy, gateway/protocol shape, UI/channel behavior, plugin SDK boundaries, and goal-driver semantics; automation can verify the gap but cannot choose the product/API rollout.

options.title: Split Staged PRs
options.body: Keep this hub open and review question infrastructure, plan mode, and goal driver work as narrower staged PRs with focused proof for each surface.

options.title: Sponsor Full Branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the broad review cost and pursue the paired implementation as one core PR after blockers and proof are resolved.

options.title: Narrow Or Defer
options.body: Maintainers can reject or narrow parts of the roadmap if some primitives should wait, move behind a smaller API design, or stay out of core for now.

recommendation.title: Split Staged PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this hub open and review question infrastructure, plan mode, and goal driver work as narrower staged PRs with focused proof for each surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Current source provenance and release/current-main routing make vincentkoc the best available owner for the broad core runtime direction decision.
